metadata.source_note: Exact current codified source unit for subsection 12-700(a)(10). The anchor range starts at subdivision (10) and stops before subdivision (11), excluding the chapter table of contents, prior historical rate schedules, sibling subsections, annotations, and other Chapter 229 sections. This source establishes the individual resident ordinary-tax schedules, low-rate phaseouts, recapture provisions, and the distinct trust-or-estate rate applicable to taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2024. It does not certify a complete annual Connecticut income-tax liability.
metadata.title: Connecticut General Statutes Section 12-700(a)(10), resident income-tax schedules for taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2024
